chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Habib ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from 'Amr ibn Thabit, from Abi al-Jarud, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said: “The thief of the dead has his hand cut, just as the thief of the living has his hand cut.”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَا: Imam 'Ali عليه السلام, the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.يُقْطَعُ: the prescribed cutting penalty is carried out

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on stealing from the dead in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام that theft from the dead is treated like theft from the living with respect to the prescribed punishment. It indicates that the property and sanctity connected to the deceased remain protected under Islamic law.
